listen_address.description: IP address the exporter listens on for incoming HTTP requests from Prometheus.

listen_port.description: Port number the exporter listens on for Prometheus scrapes.

instances.description: List of PgBouncer instances to monitor, each specified as 'host:port'.

dsn_password.description: Password for authenticating to PgBouncer (if required by PgBouncer's auth_type). Leave empty if using trust or other non-password auth.

metrics_path.description: HTTP path under which metrics are exposed (e.g., /metrics or /pgbouncer/metrics).

collect_database_metrics.description: Whether to collect per-database metrics (e.g., total queries, active connections per DB).

collect_pool_metrics.description: Whether to collect per-pool metrics (e.g., pool size, waiting clients per pool).

log_level.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, or error.

connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a response from PgBouncer. Set to 0 to disable timeout.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the exporter's metrics endpoint (requires cert/key files).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format) when TLS is enabled.

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format) when TLS is enabled.
